svg.title: Forest Service · British Columbia · Parks — vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the supplied raster reference using smooth parametric oval curves, a joined rectangular tab, individually outlined ring lettering, hand-built PARKS capitals, a layered fir tree, mountain contours and water lines. Flat colours; transparent outside the badge. No bitmap, auto-traced contour, external image or font dependency. This is a new reconstruction, not recovered official production artwork.
